title: What Comes After Harm? Mapping Reparative Actions in AI through Justice Frameworks
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain a benchmark that measures any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on a taxonomy of reparative actions following AI-related harm.
findings: The paper does not analyze or present any findings related to religion or faith. The only mention is a passing example of 'religious authors' suing for copyright infringement, which is incidental to the paper's main analysis of reparative actions.
